secrets.name: forge-dev
secrets.how: Forgejo → account @host:forge_dev_user@ → Settings → Applications → a token with write:repository

secrets.name: forge-merge
secrets.how: Forgejo → account @host:forge_merge_user@ (in the merge whitelist of branch main) → a token with write:repository

secrets.name: review
secrets.how: Forgejo → account @host:forge_review_user@ (in the approvals whitelist of branch main) → a token with write:repository

secrets.name: devcheck
secrets.how: Forgejo → the CI account → a token with write:repository (commit statuses only)

secrets.name: claude-token
secrets.how: claude setup-token on any machine (one browser sign-in to the owner's subscription, valid one year) — the token it prints, bare, after CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=; renew before the year ends

secrets.name: pult
secrets.how: optional: a Telegram bot from BotFather and the owner's chat id — a copy of critical alerts

secrets.name: llm-openrouter
secrets.how: optional (KD-9217): the OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai → Keys) — a card's session on a model of this provider sends it instead of the host's Claude token

secrets.name: llm-fireworks
secrets.how: optional (KD-9217): the Fireworks API key (fireworks.ai → API Keys) — a card's session on a model of this provider sends it instead of the host's Claude token

secrets.name: llm-deepseek
secrets.how: optional (KD-9217): the DeepSeek API key (platform.deepseek.com → API keys) — a card's session on a model of this provider sends it instead of the host's Claude token

secrets.name: llm-custom
secrets.how: optional (KD-9217): the key of the custom Anthropic-compatible endpoint set per model in the cabinet — a card's session on a model of this provider sends it instead of the host's Claude token

secrets.name: llm-anthropic
secrets.how: Optional direct anthropic API key; separately metered API usage, not a subscription credential.

secrets.name: llm-openai
secrets.how: Optional direct openai API key; separately metered API usage, not a subscription credential.
